name: Tianjin D-power 48V 13S
description: Protocol for Tianjin D-power 48V 13S 25Ah Li-ion battery pack

messages.name: Pack Identification
messages.description: Manufacturing date and serial number encoded as YYDDMMSSSS decimal format

fields.name: pack_identifier
fields.description: 32-bit manufacturing identifier in decimal format YYDDMMSSSS. YY=year (add 2000), DD=day, MM=month, SSSS=4-digit serial number. Example: 2018095346 means manufactured Sept 18, 2020, serial 5346

messages.name: Cell Voltage
messages.description: Individual cell voltage in mV. Sent as a series of 13 messages, one per cell in sequence.

fields.name: cell_voltage_mv
fields.description: Cell voltage in millivolts (series of 13 sequential messages for cells 0-12)

messages.name: State of Charge
messages.description: Current SOC and maximum SOC capacity in milliamp-hours (mAh)

fields.name: soc
fields.description: Current state of charge in mAh

fields.name: max_soc
fields.description: Maximum state of charge capacity in mAh

messages.name: BMS Information
messages.description: Extended frame containing ASCII text with hardware, firmware, and BMS type information

fields.name: bms_info
fields.description: ASCII string with hardware/firmware/BMS type (up to 8 characters)

messages.name: Battery State
messages.description: Battery state machine indicator (idle, standby, charging phases)

messages.name: Sleep Command
messages.description: Extended frame command that puts the battery to sleep (DLC=0, no data)

messages.name: Wake Command
messages.description: Extended frame command to wake the battery up (DLC=0, no data)
